description: The Pro cold-weather check: the long-term mean daily minimum and mean temperature of a place in a month (NASA POWER monthly data of the place's grid cell, GeoNames places, a stored table: no outside call) against the design's minimum laying temperature with its source, and a verdict: comfortable, marginal, prewarm or unknown. A place by its GeoNames id or by coordinates (its nearest place in the table, with the distance). Always paid: the site shows no free part. input: {place: a GeoNames id (number) or "lat, lon", month: 1 to 12}. $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; no free allowance; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.

design.description: Instead of a sentence: the design field of a design_cable answer.

input.description: input: {place: a GeoNames id (number) or "lat, lon", month: 1 to 12}

items.description: Instead of one: a project's list, 1 to 50 items, each {sentence | spec | design, input}; always in full, paid per item.

lang.description: Any of the site's 15 languages; default en.

sentence.description: The cable in words or its designation, as design_cable takes it.

spec.description: Instead of a sentence: a spec as design_cable takes it.

name: cold_weather_check
title: Cold-weather check: a place and a month against the cable's laying limit
